tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi sa bcad bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud 'di la don bzhi ste gleng gzhi dang*/ gleng bslang dang*/ rgyud kyi gzhung dngos dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba'o// gleng gzhi la drug ste/ chos dang*/ sdud pa po dang*/ dus dang*/ ston pa po dang*/ gnas dang*/ 'khor dang*/ ston pa'i che bas bzhugs pa'o// de la gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'o// gleng bslang ba la gnyis/ ston pas bslang ba dang*/ 'khor gyis bslang ba'o// ston pas bslang ba la drug rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang*/ thabs 'od zer gyi spro bsdu dang*/ 'bras bu ngan song las grol bar bstan pa dang*/ mchod pa sngon du song bas ched du brjod pa dang*/ brgya byin la sogs pas ngo mtshar bstan pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ngo mi mtshar bar bstan pa'o// 'khor gyis gleng bslang ba la brgyad de/ brgya byin gyis ston pa la spobs pa skyed cig par gsol ba btab pa dang*/ nor bu dri ma med pa gang du skyes lung bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa dang*/ bha ga wān gyis dus la bab na nyon cig par gdams pa bstan pas/ brgya byin gyis dus la bab par khas blangs pa dang*/ dri ma med pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa dang*/ brgya byin la sogs pa skyo ba skyes te 'gyel ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das la nor bu dri ma med pa sdug bsngal las thar ba'i thabs zhus pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon cig par gdams pa dang*/ zhu ba dngos so// de la gnyis/ brgya byin byis zhus pa dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs pas zhus pa'o// rgyud kyi gzhung dngos la gnyis te/ ston pas 'khor byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ rgyud dngos so// de la gnyis te/ shākya thub pas gsungs pa kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis dang*/ phyag na rdo rje zhal nas gsungs pa brtag pa phyi ma'o// kun rig gi dkyil 'khor drug ste/

sngags kyi phreng ba phan yon bstan pa dang*/ nang gi dkyil 'khor du 'gro bas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ ras ris la brten pa'i dngos grub dang*/ tshe 'das kyi phyir ngan song gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi bre brag rnams bstan pa dang*/ nor bu dri ma med pa ngan song las thon pa phan yod dang bcas pa bstan pa dang*/ rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sngags kyi phreng ba dngos dang*/ phan yon no// de la gnyis te/ sngags thos pa la sogs pa'i phan yon dang*/ sngags de dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i phan yon no// nang gi dkyil 'khor du song ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ brgya byin gyis bshad par gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i don tu ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang*/ bshad pa dngos so// de la gnyis te/ nang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor ro// phyi ma la gnyis te/ sdud pa pos mtshams sbyor dang*/ gzhung dngos so// de la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la drug ste/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas dang*/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ thig btab ste bri ba dang*/ lha dgod pa dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// thig btab ste bri ba la gnyis/ mdo dang rgyas pa'o// zhugs te bsgrub pa la bzhi ste/ slob dpon bdag dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung du 'dug pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te bsgrub pa dang*/ mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma gtang ba'o// slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ mdo dang*/ rgyas pa'o// de la gnyis te/ 'jug pa dang*/ dbang ngo*// dang po la gsum ste/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa sems bskyed pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa dang*/ dam tshig bsgrags pa sngon du 'gro bas sdom pa 'bogs pa'o// dbang la gnyis te/

dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes bla ma la mchod pa phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa'o// ras ris la brten pa'i dngos grub la gnyis te/ sdud pa po'i mtshams sbyor dang*/ gzhung dngos so// de la gsum ste/ rten ras ris bri ba dang*/ rten rdzogs pa la rab tu gnas pa bya ba dang*/ rten bsgrub pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bsnyen dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'o// tshe 'das kyi phyir ngan song gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi bye brag bstan pa la bzhi ste/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' gnang ba dang*/ ngan song gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs bshad pa'i gzhung dngos dang*/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'o// gsum pa la dgu ste/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te mchod rten dbus su bzhag ste sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ dbang bskur te dri'i gtsang khang du bzhag pas sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ mchod rten bya bas sbyang ba dang*/ bzlas pa bya bas sbyang ba dang*/ sbyin sreg bya bas sbyang ba dang*/ ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ rten med pa la sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ phyir bzlog gis sdig pa sbyang ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rten ro yod pa la sbyang ba dang*/ rten med pa gzugs brnyan la dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba'o// ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba la brgyad de/ thab khung gi dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa dang*/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te mchod pa dang*/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bsreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ro byin gyis brlab te chas su gzhug pa dang*/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i rim pa dngos dang*/ mchod rten gdab pa dang*/ rtags dang phan yon 'byung bar bstan pa'o// de la gsum ste/ rtags dngos dang*/ rtags ma byung na bskyar ba'i cho ga dang*/

bskyar chog byas pas rtags 'byung bar bstan pa'o// sdig pa sbyang ba'i phan yon la gnyis te/ phan yon dngos dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa la sogs pa'i rten la thabs sngags phyag rgya med na mi 'byongs par bstan pa'o// nor bu'i dri ma med pa'i 'od ngan song nas thon pa'i thabs phan yon dang bcas pa la bdun te/ brgya byin la sogs pas cho ga ji lta ba bzhin byas pas dri ma med pa sdug bsngal las thar te dga' ldan gnas su skyes pa dang*/ nor bu dri ma med pa la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te ngo mtshar bar bstan pa dang*/ brgya byin la sogs pas ched du brjod par bstan pa dang*/ dga' ldan pas ngo mtshar te ched du brjod pa dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyis ya mtshan skyes te ched du brjod pa dang*/ yang dga' ldan pas ngo mtshar skyes te ched du brjod pa dang*/ nor bu dri ma med pa la sogs pas mchod pa byas te slar 'dong par bstan pa'o// rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa la bzhi ste/ brgya byin la sogs pas bshad par gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon cig par gdams par bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dngos dang*/ bha ga wān gyis brgya byin la yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i rgyud de 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams kyi don du bag yod par sgrubs shig par bkas gnang ba'o// gsum pa la lnga ste chos dang ldan par thos par bstan pa dang*/ lha rnams kyis snod dang ldan par khas blangs pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don byas pa'i phan yon dang*/ brgya byin la sogs pas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa dang*/ rgyud bcang ba la sogs pa'i phan yon bstan pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ dris pa dang*/ lan no// phyag na rdo rje'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i brtag pa phyi ma la gnyis te/ sdud pa po'i mtshams sbyong sngon du song bas ston pa gdan las bzhengs te phyag byas nas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang*/ rgyud kyi gzhung ngo*// de la lnga ste/

shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ tshe dpag tu med pa gsung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ me ltar 'bar ba phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor ro// dang po la lnga ste sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma la dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa dang*/ phyag rgya'i ye shes dang*/ dngos grub kyi ye shes dang*/ nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi skyes rgyud bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas pa'o// slob dpon gyi las la gnyis te/ bri zhing dgod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ bdag bskyed la mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'o// dri ma med pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa la gnyis te/ dris pa dang*/ lan no// phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ phyag na rdo rje la 'khor de bzhin gshegs pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'jig rten pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor ro// dang po la gnyis te/ gleng bslang ba dang*/ gzhung ngo*// snga ma la gnyis te/ 'khor gyis gleng bslang ba dang*/ ston pas gleng bslang ba'o// gzhung la gsum/ sngags kyi phreng ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa'o// bar pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon kyi las dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'o// slob dpon gyi las la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa bstan pa'o// phyag na rdo rje la 'jig rten pas bskor ba la drug ste/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gza' chen po brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/

'jigs byed brgyad chung ma dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o// phyag na rdo rje la 'khor rgyal po chen po bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o// bar pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// slob dpon gyis las la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ slob dpon zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// phyag na rdo rje la phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ snying po'i rjes su gnang ba byin te bsgrub pa bstan pa dang*/ phyogs skyong rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa la gnyis te/ spyir khas blangs pa dang*/ bye brag tu khas blangs pa'o// gza' chen brgyad 'khor rgyu skar dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// slob dpon gyi las la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ zhugs te lha bsgrub pa'o// klu chen brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa dang*/ dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa'o// bar pa la gnyis te/ dbang bskur ba dang phan yon no// dang po la gnyis te/

slob dpon gyi las chog dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// slob dpon gyi las la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// 'jigs byed brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la gsum te/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa'o// bar pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// lha chen brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi ye shes dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la dngos grub stsol bar bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// slob dpon gyi las la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// tshe dpag tu med pa gsung gi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ gleng bslang ba dang*/ rgyud kyi gzhung bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ ston pas gleng bslang ba dang*/ 'khor gyis gleng bslang ba'o// rgyud kyi gzhung la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ ngan song du skye ba dang*/ skyes zin pa'i sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba yan lag dang bcas pa'o// slob dpon gyi las la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa la sogs pa'o// slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba yan lag dang bcas pa la bzhi ste/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ bla ma la yon dbul ba dang*/

dngos grub kyi ye shes dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o// ngan song gi sdig pa sbyang ba la gnyis te/ lha rnams kyis zhus pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'o// de la gnyis te/ tshe 'das la sbyar ba dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa la sbyar ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dbang bskur bas sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ bzlas pas sbyang ba dang*/ sbyin sreg gis sbyang ba bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mdo dang*/ rgyas pa'o// sbyin sreg gis sbyang ba la bzhi ste/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod do// rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa la bzhi ste/ rgyud bris pa'i phan yon dang*/ rgyud mnga' gsol ba'i phan yon dang*/ rgyud bshad pa'i phan yon dang*/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i phan yon no// 'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi ye shes dang*/ phyag rgya'i ye shes so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// slob dpon gyi las la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ zhugs shing dbang bskur ba dngos dang*/ bla ma la yon dbul zhing bka' nod pa'o// dngos grub kyi ye shes la gnyis/ mdo dang*/ rgyas pa'o// de la gnyis te rang don dang*/ gzhan don bstan pa'o// de la lnga ste/ phrin las bzhi mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi las tshogs dang*/ phrin las bzhi'i mjug sdud bstan pa dang*/ 'khor gyis legs so bya ba byin pa'o// phyag rgya'i ye shes la gnyis te/ mdo dang*/ rgyas pa'o// de la gsum ste/ lag pa byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ phyag rgya bcing thabs dngos dang*/ zhar las 'byung ba sngags bstan pa'o// me ltar 'bar ba phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/

lha rnams kyis zhus pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rje bshad pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ phrin las bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis te// bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang*/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o// phrin las la gsum ste/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang ngo*// dang po la bcu ste/ thab khung dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa dang*/ phyogs kyis shis pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sgrub pa'i chas dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par dang*/ yam shing bud shing gi khyad par dang*/ bud shing la me sbar ba sngon du song bas me lha'i khyad par bstan pa dang*/ me lha dang ye shes kyi lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dngos dang*/ bsgrub bya la bsrung ba dang*/ gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga dang*/ ma grub na bskyar ba'i cho ga bstan pa'o// rgyas pa la bcu gcig ste/ sbyin sreg gi gnas dang*/ thab dang dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa dang*/ sgrub pa po'i chas dang*/ phyogs kyis shis pa sngon du song bas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor bya ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas brjod kyi khyad par dang*/ mchod pa dang yam shing dang bud shing gi khyad par dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par dang*/ me lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ ye shes kyi lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang bsrung ba'o// dbang la bcu gsum ste/ lha dang bsam pa bstan pa dang*/ gnas dang thab khung gi khyad par dang*/ yam shing dang bud shing bstan pa dang*/ bsreg pa'i rdzas dang*/ thab khung la byug pa bya zhing mtshan ma bri ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i chas dang*/ sngon du song bas phyogs dang dus kyi shis pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par dang*/ sbyin sreg gi me lha'i khyad par dang*/

sbyin sreg gi phan yon dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ gshegs su gsol zhing rang la bsrung ba'o// rjes su yi rang ba la bdun te/ gang gis bstod pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i yul dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bstod pa'i tshig dang*/ bstod pa'i phan yon dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dngos so// gang gis bstod cing mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i yul dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ tshig dang*/ phan yan no// ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i dbu nas zhabs kyi bar bsdus pa'i don rdzogs so// //bshad srol so so mi 'dra ba// rin chen bzang po'i lugs bzhin du// bla ma'i gsung la brten byas nas// 'di ni dpal ldan sa skyar bris// oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo ma bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa a// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
